neighbours.label: the Korean noun ' 내용' (details, content), on a broad pole that responds to much Korean and Japanese text
fire: 더 많은 내용을 알고 싶으시면 전화하세요.
quiet: 더 많은 사진을 보고 싶으시면 전화하세요.

notes: Card flags broad (1.3%): ' 내용' x3, ' 연결' x2, '更新', 'isen', '逮捕'. Probes: ' 내용' 0.44-0.46, but Korean and Japanese sentences without it also reached 0.31-0.47, and German 'beweisen' 0.307. The baseline is high, so a word test is likely to fail; I test it as the only repeated token.
